dessin: A cropped excerpt of a printed topographic map seen from above, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge: the pale paper color #FBFCF8 covers the whole image, no outer background color, no frame, no border, no outline around the image, no margin; the drawing is cut cleanly by the four image edges as if the map continued beyond them. Vegetation only: two or three irregular patches of forest with flat pale green fill #D3DFC3 and a thin green outline #6E8B4E, each patch sprinkled with small green tree dots #6E8B4E in a regular pattern; the rest of the excerpt plain pale. No water, no roads, no buildings. No text, no letters, no numbers, no contour labels, no symbols other than those described, nothing else.
